turns.question: How many degrees Celsius warmer was Istanbul than Amsterdam on average in daily temperature on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no temperature metric, so I cannot give the Istanbul-minus-Amsterdam difference. The closest metrics are the business ones (revenue, orders, leads, bookings, site sessions), none of which measure weather; query_metrics returned no freshness statement because no query was run.
